The fixture is the source SFZ mapping text only. No audio samples are bundled. The upstream README describes this bank as assembled from Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL) CC0 samples with light editing. The test fixture is retained to regression-test declared MIDI key ranges, sample paths, tuning opcodes, and sequence positions. It does not imply that audio samples are installed, decodable, or perceptually qualified.
